integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete symbolic proof, with standalone exhaustive tests on thirteen finite examples as corroboration only. Same-model scientific review, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: Classification for finite completely zero-simple semigroups only; no infinite-case theorem; ordinary inner partial automorphisms, not the full partial automorphism inverse monoid. 2026 standalone has a 2023 conceptual predecessor with uninspected original source details, creating a residual priority and scope-age risk; no independent audit.
title: Partial inner automorphisms of finite completely zero-simple semigroups
